title: Assembly of finite scalar comparisons
statement: Given nonempty FiniteScalarLevelData l E j o n for every n, there is a family of natural isomorphisms finiteExtension l E j o n ⋙ scalarReductionRestriction l E X n ≅ scalarReductionRestriction l E U n ⋙ IntegralOpenReduction.extension l E j o.

source.place: Tags 03DI and 0E8I; natural assembly over modules.

proof.text: Choose the finite-level data at n. Its objectwise isomorphisms and naturality equation assemble directly with NatIso.ofComponents.

mathlib_searches.results: Mathlib NatIso.ofComponents is the direct assembly API.

lean.statement: theorem openQuotientScalarFiniteCompatibilityAssembly (o : IntegralOpenReduction.Operations l E j) (h : ∀ n : ℕ, Nonempty (FiniteScalarLevelData l E j o n)) : Nonempty (∀ n : ℕ, IntegralOpenReduction.finiteExtension l E j o n ⋙ scalarReductionRestriction l E X n ≅ scalarReductionRestriction l E U n ⋙ IntegralOpenReduction.extension l E j o)
